title: Field Report: standpipe isolated, Hilltop Tank falling

fields.organization: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer — Distribution
fields.summary: Orchard Standpipe isolated since 09:34; wells W-1 to W-3 off. Hilltop Tank 25.4 ft and falling about 0.4 ft an hour. Zone 2 pressure at the Summit Drive gauge 58 psi. Flushing the two downstream hydrants after sampling.
recommendations: Set the Hilltop Tank level for starting Mill Road Booster Station

instructorNote: Isolation has a cost by the evening. Watch for a booster trigger level.

snapshot.title: Orchard Standpipe Site Re-Screening — Manual Operation Readiness

fields.organization: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer — Operations & Maintenance
fields.inspector: RWTP Control Room Operator, Plant Operations
fields.summary: Re-screening for manual operation per ERP Section 9.1. Hilltop Tank level at 14.2 ft (within normal range, C3). Northgate Reservoir at 11.8 ft (within normal range, C3). No pressure drops in Zone 2. All other HMIs and RTUs are stable. No new alarms. Site remains isolated via IC-2 and under FBI forensic hold. No system restarts authorized. All actions follow C2 and C4.

findings.notes: Inactive since 07/2024 per MDWS-OTSEC-2026 Section 3 and C7. Continues to report as closed.
Tripped at 02:15 and 04:30; remains open. Lockout/Tagout applied.
Stream preserved on MBW-NVR-01. No further tampering observed.
0.7 mg/L. Manual grab sample confirmed. No change since 03:45 AM.
Confirmed via PIT-501 pressure trend. No flow to Zone 2.
No newer backup than MDWS-BKP-PLC-02-032025. Program live on PLC-02 and on MBW-DEV-LT01 (user jmolina). Not in official archive.
IC-2 locked in. No remote access attempts detected.
Confirmed via FBI liaison (555-034-1101). No system access authorized.
Hourly grab samples at AIT-611 in progress. Lab results to be submitted via MDWS-ERP-2026 Section 8.3.
All HMIs stable. No new alarms since 10:00.

actionsTaken: Verified Hilltop Tank and Northgate Reservoir levels via HMI and manual gauge
Confirmed IC-2 isolation status via PIT-501 pressure trend
Reviewed RTU-02 event log for 02:00–05:00; no anomalies
Initiated hourly grab sampling at AIT-611 per ERP Section 8.3
Notified Incident Commander and SCADA / IT Security Manager of readiness for manual supervision
recommendations: Await formal verification of PLC-02 program integrity from SCADA / IT Security Manager and FBI liaison before any return-to-service actions
Continue hourly grab sampling and pressure monitoring until formal all-clear is issued
Do not initiate any system restarts or manual overrides until FBI forensic team provides clearance

fields.signature: RWTP Control Room Operator, Plant Operations

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms the Control Room Operator’s status as the primary on-site monitor. The operator must not initiate any return-to-service steps. Watch for any attempt to bypass verification or restart systems without FBI clearance.
